title: Receiver Behavior ambiguous subject for MUST return
description: Location: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md, Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior section, line 315. Text: 'The calling server is not informed of this suppression; Peer/receipt MUST return a normal success response.' Issue: The subject of 'MUST return a normal success response' is ambiguous. Because the sentence opens with 'The calling server is not informed', a reader may parse 'Peer/receipt MUST return' as still referring to the calling server. The intended subject is the receiving server. Suggested rephrasing: 'The receiving server MUST return a normal success response; the calling server is not informed of the suppression.'
close_reason: Resolved: phrase no longer present in current text
